name: NTempest::gnoise32_
meaning: Holds the 64 dwords the state advance and the hashes read

name: s_noiseGradients
meaning: Holds -1 + 2k/15 for k = 0 to 15, the gradient components of the noise

name: s_perspectiveDepthFactor
meaning: Holds -2.0, the factor of near·far in the perspective depth term

name: s_dragTravel
meaning: Holds 8.0, the travel either sum must reach for a slow release to count as a drag

name: s_defaultDistance
meaning: Holds 100.0, the default distance and eye x

name: s_defaultFarClip
meaning: Holds 5000.0, the default far clip

name: s_defaultNearClip
meaning: Holds 8.0, the default near clip

name: s_orthoDepth
meaning: Holds 500.0, the orthographic depth either side of zero

name: CCamera::vftable
meaning: Holds the camera's vtable: 0x7acd80, then 0x442a70

name: s_scalarPropertyVftable
meaning: Holds the scalar property vtable: delete, evaluate, verify, store

name: s_vectorPropertyVftable
meaning: Holds the vector property vtable: delete, evaluate, verify, store

name: s_propertySetVftable
meaning: Holds the camera base's vtable: 0x7acd10, then 0x442a70

name: CBaseManaged::vftable
meaning: Holds the base property vtable: 0x7acb50, 0x7acb30, 0x7acb40

name: s_anglePropertyVftable
meaning: Holds the angle property vtable: delete, the scalar evaluate and verify, store

name: mathlib
meaning: Pairs the Lua math library's names with its C functions, ending in a null pair

name: __xc_a
meaning: Lists the C++ static initializers __cinit runs in ascending order, up to __xc_z at 0x82e030

name: s_screenScaleX
meaning: Holds K1 = a/sqrt(a² + 1) for the display aspect a; 0.8 in the file

name: s_screenScaleY
meaning: Holds K2 = 1/sqrt(a² + 1) for the display aspect a; 0.6 in the file

name: s_bindingCommands
meaning: Pairs the 26 movement and mouse binding commands' names with their handlers

name: s_inputControlSourcePath
meaning: Holds the source path the object file asserts with, ending InputControl.cpp

name: s_inputControlTag
meaning: Holds the path ending InputControl.h, the allocation tag of CInputControl

name: s_cameraTag
meaning: Holds "HCAMERA", the tag of camera allocations and handles

name: s_propertySlotsTag
meaning: Holds ".PAVCBaseManaged@@", the tag of slot array allocations

name: s_particleDensity
meaning: Holds the particle density in [0, 1]; 1.0 in the file

name: s_randomInfinity
meaning: Holds +inf, set at startup; nothing reads it

name: s_randomInvTwoPi
meaning: Holds 1/2π, set at startup; read only by unreached noise

name: s_randomTwoPi
meaning: Holds 2π, set at startup; read only by unreached noise

name: s_gaussianSpareFloat
meaning: Holds the spare deviate of 0x44f9b0, 0 when empty; one for every state

name: s_gaussianSpareDouble
meaning: Holds the spare deviate of 0x44fa70, 0 when empty; one for every state

name: s_inputControl
meaning: Holds the CInputControl singleton

name: s_cameraInvTwoPi
meaning: Holds 1/2π (0x3e22f983), set at startup, read by 0x7abbe0

name: s_cameraTwoPi
meaning: Holds 2π (0x40c90fdb), set at startup, read by 0x7abbe0

name: s_defaultFov
meaning: Holds π/2, set at startup, the default field of view

name: s_cameraInfinity
meaning: Holds +inf, set at startup; nothing reads it

name: s_cameraInvTwoPi2
meaning: Holds 1/2π, set at startup; nothing reads it

name: s_cameraTwoPi2
meaning: Holds 2π, set at startup; read only by 0x7adf50

name: s_cameraInfinity2
meaning: Holds +inf, set at startup; nothing reads it
